description:
Remote Position
 Could potentially lead to a perm position however, that is far from a guarantee. Standard hours are 8 am-5pm, or 8:30-5:30.
 Will have to go on site for a few days the first week for training, computer set up, etc. but after that should be almost entirely remote

 Minimum 5 years of software development experience 
 Strong experience with C# 
 Knowledge of Object Oriented Programming/Design 
 Experience with ASP.NET, JavaScript, SQL Server and extJS 
 Experience developing large software applications 
 Excellent oral and written communication skills 
 Actuarial or Pension Admin knowledge a plus 
 Current Microsoft Certification a plus

 To know more about the position or to schedule an interview, please contact after applying to the position here:
